title: Sales Staff
description:
**Company Description** 
 Greentek India Limited is an integrated solar engineering company with roots in the solar sector since 1997 and incorporation in 2007\. The organization designs, manufactures, executes, monitors, and maintains solar solutions ranging from residential rooftops to institutional hot\-water plants and utility\-scale projects. Its EPC business spans residential rooftop projects under PM Surya Ghar, commercial and industrial plants under CAPEX, OPEX and PPA models, operations and maintenance services, and Adani Solar module supply as an authorized channel partner. Greentek operates a BIS\-licensed manufacturing unit in Shabaspalle, Medak, producing solar flat plate collectors, absorber fins and storage tanks, and is ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015 certified and MNRE approved. The company serves clients such as L\&T, Indian Oil, Wipro, Shapoorji Pallonji, SECI, CPWD, ESIC, and leading educational and medical institutes, with operations across India, UAE and Kenya.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Sales Staff role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Secunderābād. The role involves identifying and qualifying potential customers, promoting Greentek’s solar products and EPC services, and managing the entire sales cycle from lead generation to closing. Daily activities include conducting client meetings and site visits, preparing proposals and quotations, coordinating with technical and operations teams to ensure accurate solutions, and maintaining detailed records of interactions in CRM or internal systems. The Sales Staff will be expected to meet sales targets, follow up on inquiries, participate in marketing or promotional events, and provide ongoing account management and support to existing clients. The role also includes staying updated on solar industry trends, government schemes and policies, and communicating these effectively to customers.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong sales, negotiation, and persuasion skills, with the ability to achieve and exceed sales targets.
* Customer relationship management abilities, including lead follow\-up, account management, and after\-sales service.
* Knowledge of solar energy solutions, EPC projects, and basic technical understanding of solar systems (training support may be provided).
* Effective communication and presentation skills in English and relevant local languages.
* Good organizational, planning, and time\-management skills to handle multiple prospects and projects.
* Comfort with using MS Office, CRM tools, and digital communication platforms for reporting and coordination.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Business, Engineering, Marketing, or a related field preferred; relevant experience in solar or industrial sales is an advantage.
* Willingness to work on\-site in Secunderābād and travel to client locations as required.

title: Management Trainee - E Commerce
description:
**Company: Sid’s Farm**
**About Sid’s Farm**
 Sid’s Farm is a premium dairy brand committed to delivering pure, high\-quality milk and dairy products directly to consumers. With a strong focus on freshness, ethical sourcing, and customer trust, Sid’s Farm continues to expand its footprint across modern trade, key accounts, and alternate sales channels.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Sid’s Farm is looking for a dynamic and result\-driven to acquire and manage key accounts, aggregators, and modern trade chains as alternate revenue sources. The role is responsible for driving revenue growth, managing daily sales performance, monitoring offers, ensuring timely receivables, and building strong strategic partnerships.
   

  

**🔍 What You’ll Do**
* Develop and maintain strategic relationships with key accounts to drive sales and revenue growth for Sid’s Farm products.
* Identify, acquire, and manage key accounts, aggregators, and modern trade partners.
* Collaborate with Merchandisers to build a strong pipeline of high\-quality prospects and generate sustained demand.
* Maintain strong working relationships with key partner personnel at head offices.
* Coordinate agent support, including training, merchandising, and below\-the\-line (BTL) marketing execution.
* Develop and deploy effective business propositions to accelerate revenue growth.
* Provide back\-office support including preparing quotations, negotiating pricing, and managing customer onboarding and deployment activities.
* Play a key role in new business pitches and ensure seamless onboarding of new clients.
* Act as the primary liaison between customers and internal teams to ensure smooth coordination.
* Monitor daily sales, promotional offers, and performance metrics across accounts.
* Ensure timely collections and effectively manage accounts receivable.
* Perform account reconciliations to maintain accurate statements and invoices.
* Propose innovative promotions and in\-store activities to improve shelf off\-take and visibility.
* Present periodic reports on account performance, goals, and quarterly initiatives to stakeholders.
* Analyse client data and sales trends to enhance customer relationship management and business outcomes.


**✅ What We’re Looking For**
 Required Skills \& Qualifications
   

  

* Proven experience in sales, business development, and new account acquisition.
* Strong account management and relationship\-building skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong negotiation abilities.
* Ability to design and improve distribution processes and revenue channels.
* Experience managing inventory and stock across multiple regions.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills.
* High level of ownership, accountability, and result orientation.


 Why Join Sid’s Farm?
   

  

 At Sid’s Farm, we believe operational excellence is key to delivering freshness and quality to our customers. Join us and be part of a fast\-growing brand that values precision, ownership, and teamwork.

title: Sales Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 Pure \& Cure Technology (PNC) is a premium industrial platform specializing in water and wastewater treatment components and solutions. The company partners with leading global manufacturers to offer a wide range of products, including pumps, membranes, membrane housings, chemicals, dosing pumps, ion exchange resins, drives, tanks, pipes, fittings, valves, and digital instrumentation. PNC serves quality\-conscious organizations across India through a strong sales and service network. The team is supported by experienced engineers and R\&D experts who provide technical guidance, training, seminars, and symposiums on water and wastewater treatment. PNC focuses on long\-term client relationships through committed service, reliable technical support, and consistently high product standards.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Sales Executive role based in Uppal. The Sales Executive will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, generating leads, and managing the sales cycle for water and wastewater treatment components and solutions. Day\-to\-day tasks include meeting with prospective and existing customers, presenting product offerings, preparing quotations, negotiating terms, and closing deals in line with company targets. The role involves coordinating with technical and service teams to understand client requirements, provide accurate product recommendations, and ensure timely after\-sales support. The Sales Executive will also maintain accurate sales records, participate in product training sessions, and represent PNC at customer meetings, trainings, and industry events as required.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong sales and business development skills, including lead generation, customer relationship management, and negotiation.
* Knowledge of industrial water and wastewater treatment products or related engineering solutions, with the ability to understand technical specifications.
* Effective communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex solutions in a clear and simple manner.
* Ability to work on\-site, manage field visits, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams such as engineering, service, and R\&D.
* Prior experience in industrial or technical sales is preferred; experience in the water treatment sector is an advantage.
* Relevant qualification in Engineering, Science, Business, or a related field is beneficial.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and proficiency in basic office and CRM software.
* Willingness to travel within the region and attend trainings, seminars, and customer events as required.

title: Sales Manager

 The ideal candidate should have strong experience in SaaS solution selling, account expansion, proposal preparation, and digital transformation consulting across multiple Zoho applications.

* Develop and execute sales strategies to drive Zoho solution revenue
* Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets
* Expand business through new logo acquisition and key account growth
* Drive up selling and cross\-selling across the Zoho ecosystem


 Lead \& Pipeline Management
   

  

  

* Oversee structured lead qualification using BANT framework
* Ensure proper pipeline creation, deal staging, and forecasting accuracy
* Maintain strong conversion ratios across the sales funnel

 Proposal Development \& Commercial Structuring

 Enterprise \& CXO Engagement

 Deal Closure \& Cross\-Functional Coordination

 Customer Retention \& Account Growth
   

  

  

* Drive long\-term customer relationships and key account retention

* Identify new opportunities within existing customer base

*

Team members contribute to a mission that supports rural communities and a more prosperous, sustainable agricultural future for all.

The role involves following call scripts, maintaining accurate records of conversations in the system, and updating customer details after each interaction. The Tele Caller will also support lead generation, schedule follow\-up calls or visits for the sales team, and provide feedback on customer needs and market trends. Collaboration with sales, marketing, and customer support teams is expected to ensure consistent communication and a positive customer experience.

* Strong verbal communication skills in a professional phone environment, with clear and respectful customer interaction.
* Basic knowledge or interest in agriculture, seeds, pesticides, and micro\-nutrients, or willingness to learn quickly.
* Ability to maintain accurate call logs, update customer databases, and follow structured call scripts or guidelines.
* Sales or customer service aptitude, including handling objections, identifying opportunities, and building rapport over the phone.
* Comfort working with basic computer tools and CRM or call\-tracking software.
* Ability to work on\-site in
 
 Kompally
 
 , manage time effectively, and meet daily or weekly call and follow\-up targets.
